why_this_amendment_exists: The frozen rule said a distributable mixture contains every seed of every branch at EQUAL MEMBER weight, which yields twelve members at 1/12. Measuring the D2 decomposition afterwards showed that rule has a consequence the rule itself never states: it doubles the candidate branches' combined weight from 0.25 to 0.50, and that reallocation - not the seed coverage - accounts for 89.9% of the twelve-member configuration's advantage over the pre-registered eight. A rule whose main effect is an untested weight change is not the neutral construction it was written to be.

measurement_that_forced_this.precision_note: 89.9% is the share of D2, NOT of D1. Against the current six, U - F = -0.002175 and the reallocation adds a further -0.001473 to reach D1 = -0.003649.

U_all_seeds_registered_allocation.member_weights: joint and anchor seeds at 1/8 each; A and B seeds at 1/24 each

rationale: It preserves the ONLY branch allocation that has ever passed a pre-registered test (the pair registration's 0.375/0.375/0.125/0.125). Equal-twelve changes that allocation, and no test of the new allocation exists.

It requires no seed selection. Feature 129 explicitly refused to select a seed ('No fake selected_seed'). Selecting one now would additionally be post-hoc: the per-seed C2 values were already known (42 -0.000746, 43 -0.000573, 44 -0.000565), so seed 42 is the best of the three and any 'performance-independent' rationale for choosing it would be unfalsifiable from the outside.
Its measured gain over the registered eight is small and of a well-understood kind: -0.000166 from pooling seeds, which is variance reduction, not an untested allocation change.
All six candidate member artifacts already exist (fitted 2026-09-20), so the twelve-artifact cost is already paid for this round.
what_this_decision_does_NOT_claim: That U is better than eight or twelve prospectively. All seven build years are development period; none of these numbers is confirmatory.
That the equal-twelve configuration is wrong. It remains a legitimate future challenger.
That U's own head guards or a direct U-vs-six CI have been measured. They have not; v3 does not report them.
decision.honest_cost: Twelve artifacts to store, verify and rebuild instead of eight. A future rebuild needs six candidate fits (~100 min at 2 workers) rather than two (~33 min). Bundle assembly itself does not refit.

independent_review.round_2_after_the_decomposition: revised to EIGHT equal members, on the grounds that eight preserves the registered allocation and adds only two artifacts; stated 'I would choose U if all-seed coverage is mandatory'
independent_review.where_this_decision_differs: It treats all-seed coverage as mandatory, because the seed choice required by eight is provably post-hoc in this session. The reviewer's eight recommendation is conditional on a 'documented, performance-independent draw', and no such draw is available after the per-seed numbers have been read.
independent_review.reviewer_correction_accepted: 134's weighting result was +0.000121 CI [-0.000203, +0.000476] and tested the EXISTING joint/anchor allocation, not these new branches. The earlier claim that '134 closed weight tuning' was too broad and has been narrowed in the README.

prohibitions_carried_forward: No weight search. The two allocations named here are the registered one and the equal-member one; nothing else is to be tried without its own registration.
No seed selection by score, under any configuration.
Correction coefficients stay joint-42's, transferred to every candidate member (member_kill_test.py:216), which is the convention C1/C2 were measured under.
The production ACTIVE model does not change while feature 133's window is open (to 2026-12-28).
